description: This file defines a GestureListener class that extends Android's GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener to handle various touch gestures such as tap, long press, scroll, fling, and double tap. It includes methods for logging gesture events and identifying touch tool types and button presses.

classes.name: GestureListener
classes.description: A custom gesture listener class that handles various gesture events and logs details about the touch interactions.

methods.name: onSingleTapUp
methods.description: Handles single tap up gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long press gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onFling
methods.description: Handles fling gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onShowPress
methods.description: Handles show press gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onDown
methods.description: Handles down touch event, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onDoubleTap
methods.description: Handles double tap gesture, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onDoubleTapEvent
methods.description: Handles events within a double tap, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: onSingleTapConfirmed
methods.description: Handles confirmed single tap, logs the event with touch type.

methods.name: getTouchType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of touch tool used, including pressure and buttons pressed for stylus.

methods.name: getButtonsPressed
methods.description: Returns a string listing all stylus buttons pressed during the MotionEvent.
